statement: Lavish Luster is a medical techno-beauty and biotechnological dermocosmetics company. Its mission is to bring the effectiveness of medical-aesthetic treatments into the home through clinical, safe, and accessible solutions.

facial-treatment.description: All facial, eye-and-lip, sun-protection, intensive rejuvenation, and body-treatment products.

flash-treatment.description: Instant-effect ampoules, patches, and mask products. Each product includes Application Secret, Enhanced Benefits, Active Ingredients, and Scientific Evidence.

beauty-devices.description: All techno-beauty devices, with their application instructions, benefits, and scientific evidence.
